items.name: 4af-theme
items.title: 4AF Theme
items.description: The semantic colors, radii, shadows, typography, and motion tokens used by 4AF components.

.shimmer-text.animate-text-shimmer::afte.background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent calc(50% - var(--text-shimmer-spread, 4ch)), var(--text-shimmer-highlight) 50%, transparent calc(50% + var(--text-shimmer-spread, 4ch)))

items.name: refs
items.description: React 19-safe callback and object ref composition.

items.name: motion
items.description: Spring and easing presets, mirroring the CSS motion tokens.

items.name: use-action
items.description: The run/pending/outcome/revert state machine behind ActionButton and the menu's action row — double-submit guard, unmount safety, and a revert clock each run owns.

items.name: table-of-contents-scroll
items.description: Table-of-contents scroll helpers for endpoint padding, active-entry centering, and overflow-edge affordances.

items.name: table-of-contents-tracking
items.description: Shared heading tracking and click-to-scroll behavior for table-of-contents variants.

items.name: loader
items.description: Small context and loading slot for caller-supplied indicators, with an ASCII fallback.

items.name: button
items.description: Six variants, eight sizes, optical icon alignment, and a loading state that doesn't resize.

items.name: button-group
items.description: Two or more Buttons joined into one control: flattened inner corners, one hairline per seam, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: input
items.description: A Base UI input with token-based surfaces, focus states, an optional leading icon, custom number steppers, and default, plain, and underline variants.

items.name: separator
items.description: An accessible horizontal or vertical divider built on Base UI Separator.

items.name: textarea
items.description: A multi-line field sharing the Input treatment (border, focus ring, variant/tone), plus a custom drag-to-resize corner grip in place of the native handle.

items.name: alert
items.description: An inline status line — a glyph plus a sentence, no surface. Destructive error (role=alert), amber warning, green success, neutral info, and a muted loading line with the ASCII spinner.

items.name: toggle
items.description: A button that holds a state. Fills its icon rather than swapping it.

items.name: morph
items.description: Animated content swap — icons or text. Copy to check, Follow to Following.

items.name: delete-button
items.description: A destructive button that arms on the first press and confirms on the second, with Escape, blur, and timeout exits.

items.name: copy-button
items.description: Copies to the clipboard and confirms it — visually, and to screen readers.

items.name: action-button
items.description: Runs an async action, shows pending/success/error, and reverts without resizing; pending can keep its label or show a centered loader only.

items.name: action-toggle
items.description: A toggle whose state has to be earned: it waits on an async action, lands when it succeeds, and stays put when it fails. Follow/Following, Subscribe/Subscribed.

items.name: tabs
items.description: Segment, pill, or underline tabs with a travelling indicator, a default, solid, or outline appearance for segment and pill, an optional TabsCount after a label, and optional max-width scrolling with edge fades. Base UI behaviour, Motion layout animation.

items.name: switch
items.description: A switch that slides and grows a rounded center pill toward the track center when pressed. Adaptive or fixed thumb tone.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: A checkbox whose tick draws itself in. Presses on click, not on hover.

items.name: radio
items.description: A radio group — the Checkbox's sibling, a single choice with a dot that scales in.

items.name: slider
items.description: A slider whose thumb springs between steps and grabs while held, with optional range mode, ticks, labels, and a live value tooltip. Base UI behaviour.

items.name: progress
items.description: A determinate progress bar. Base UI Progress behaviour; the fill slides on transform (translateX), never width, so it stays off the layout path.

items.name: badge
items.description: A plain, solid, or gray-outline status badge with rounded or pill-shaped boxed geometry that morphs its glyph and label on change, and springs to the new width. Status glyphs can be replaced per badge (icons) or per subtree (BadgeIconsProvider). Uses the shared Morph animation for content swaps and layout motion; tokens for the status tints (amber warning, green success).

items.name: skeleton
items.description: A loading placeholder — a square muted block that pulses while content loads, shaped entirely by utility classes; reduced motion switches the pulse off rather than strobing.

items.name: collapsible
items.description: A disclosure row built on Base UI Collapsible: the chevron rotates, the space slides open so the rows below travel rather than jump, and the content fades in out of a blur where it lands.

items.name: table
items.description: A presentational semantic table with a composable caption, two densities, optional grid lines, a pinned header, and a loading skeleton state. It has no controls and no state; install data-table for selection, sorting and row actions.

items.name: data-table
items.description: The stateful table: a checkbox column with an indeterminate select-all, a selection action row that covers the header, three-step column sorting, and a per-row actions column with a ready-made row menu that reveals on hover or focus. Composes the presentational table rather than replacing it.

items.name: table-of-contents
items.description: A table of contents that tracks visible headings, keeps the last passed section active through long prose, and offers spanning or single-heading markers.

items.name: table-of-contents-lines
items.description: A line-based table of contents where each heading has a longer rule and two shorter content rules, with a highlighted, expanding hover treatment.

items.name: empty
items.description: An empty state — a centred column of media, title, description and an action. Composable parts; borderless by default with an optional dashed placeholder outline.

items.name: text-shimmer
items.description: Text with a highlight sweeping across it — a looping working-in-progress affordance. Gradient clipped to the glyphs, switched off (not sped up) under reduced motion.

items.name: scramble-text
items.description: A short encrypted-character reveal for text that is appearing or changing, with whitespace preservation and reduced-motion support.

items.name: select
items.description: A single or multi-select on Base UI — keyboard, typeahead and collision-aware positioning — with 24px xs, 30px sm, and 34px md trigger and option-row sizes, default, ghost, and plain trigger variants, plus optional dimmed labels before values. Plain panels size to the longest option plus the check slot by default. The panel blurs and scales in from the trigger; multi-select keeps it open while animated checkbox rows are toggled, and optional separators, nested panels with selected counts, panel search, and a compact xs ghost clear footer keep related choices in place.

items.name: command-palette
items.description: A keyboard-first command and search palette with nested panels, custom panel content, fuzzy filtering, async/server-driven and paginated search, keybind hints, panel tab bars with Tab/Shift+Tab switching, and Base UI dialog/autocomplete behavior.

items.name: ascii-loader
items.description: A looping braille spinner for compact async status affordances.

items.name: matrix-loader
items.description: A 4×4 matrix dot loader with scan, twinkle, and size variants.

items.name: classic-loader
items.description: Twelve fading radial bars adapted from loading.dev, with CSS-only motion, size variants, and speed control.

items.name: select-aligned
items.description: A select with default, ghost, and plain trigger variants plus an optional dimmed label before the value that opens on its trigger rather than below it: the default and ghost panels take the trigger's width, while plain panels size to the longest option plus the check slot; the selected row lands on the value it replaces, the macOS pop-up button behaviour. Optional 24px xs trigger and popup rows, dimmed sections, and a pinned in-panel search field.

items.name: select-search
items.description: A searchable single or multi-select on Base UI's Combobox — type to filter the list, with full keyboard and ARIA support. Multi-select keeps its animated checkbox list open while choices are toggled.

items.name: tooltip
items.description: Base UI positioning and timing with a CSS scale-and-blur enter. Opens on hover and focus, flips at the viewport edge.

items.name: selection-toolbar
items.description: A bar of actions over selected text. Base UI Popover anchored to the range itself plus Base UI Toolbar for the row; plain, async, toggle and exclusive-group items. It swallows mousedown so the press can't collapse the selection, and hands the captured text to the action.

items.name: sheet
items.description: A dialog that slides in from an edge. Base UI Dialog behaviour, Motion enter/exit.

items.name: dialog
items.description: A modal centred over the page. Base UI Dialog behaviour; scales in from a blur and fades out with Motion.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.description: A modal that interrupts to force a decision. Base UI AlertDialog behaviour (role=alertdialog, no click-away dismiss); shares Dialog's Motion enter/exit.

items.name: date-picker
items.description: A date or date-range field that opens a calendar in a Base UI popover, or a bottom sheet on phones. react-day-picker owns the grid and keyboard navigation; focus opens on the selected day (or today), months slide in from the direction travelled with a CSS-only transition, and a half-picked range previews under the pointer. Default, ghost, and plain triggers in xs, sm, and md; optional clear action and hidden ISO form value. Also exports the standalone Calendar.

items.name: popover
items.description: An interactive panel anchored to a trigger. Base UI Popover behaviour with a CSS scale-and-blur enter from the trigger edge.

items.name: hover-card
items.description: A rich preview of what is behind a link, on hover and focus. Base UI PreviewCard behaviour with a CSS scale-and-blur enter from the trigger edge, plus a built-in loading skeleton.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.description: A dropdown menu on Base UI Menu (keyboard nav, submenus, checkbox/radio items, searchable selection panels, and immediate disabled-reason tooltips). Instant row highlight; CSS scale-and-blur panel enter.

items.name: sidebar
items.description: A collapsible application sidebar with default, floating, inset, and split layouts, animated split-rail icon tooltips, collapsible rows with built-in chevrons, nested rows, actions, badges, and loading skeletons.

items.name: sidebar-layout
items.description: An optional viewport shell that composes Sidebar with a contained, independently scrolling inset surface, page title header, header actions, and a left-aligned collapse trigger before the title.
